subject: Pilot plan options and on-ramp for inference-heavy workflow
messages:
From: Elliot Moore <elliot@medcanvas.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@medcanvas.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot plan components for inference-heavy workflow

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and routing controls look promising. We're trying to decide how to structure the initial pilot: we anticipate ~150k inference tokens/day (peaks ~600k) with a hard requirement for 99th percentile latency < 200ms during peak windows.

Two questions:
1) Is it better for us to start on Hosted metered (with trial credit) and then move to Dedicated when we hit higher throughput, or to start directly on a short Dedicated pilot?
2) How do you typically structure discounts/credits for a 3-month pilot if we commit to a minimum throughput / reserved capacity? Any standard on-ramp packaging you can share?

I've attached a quick usage snapshot that shows our expected pattern. We're also interested in a clear rollback path if throughput is lower than expected.

Can you put together 1–2 concrete options (pricing + mechanics) we can review with Procurements?

Best,
Elliot
Elliot Moore
Head of Integrations, MedCanvas
attachments: MedCanvas-usage-snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Moore <elliot@medcanvas.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot plan components for inference-heavy workflow

Hi Elliot — great question, thanks for the usage snapshot. Quick thoughts up front:

- If latency is a hard req and you expect steady peak windows, Dedicated for the pilot simplifies hitting the 99th percentile target.
- Hosted metered is the lowest friction for trying features, but you may see more variance in tail latency.

I'll outline two concrete options below and then propose a short call to align on commit sizing. If this sounds good I'll loop in Contracts for the pilot SOW.

Option 1 — Hosted + committed credit onramp
- 8-week pilot on our Hosted API with a $25k committed credit (applies to token usage).
- If you exceed the credit, tokens billed at a 10% discounted overage rate for the pilot period.
- Quick to start; no infra changes.

Option 2 — 3-month Dedicated pilot (recommended for latency)
- Reserve a small Dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent GPUs) for 3 months.
- 20% credit applied to the first full month as an onramp discount; 15% discount thereafter for the remainder of pilot if you maintain the committed throughput.
- Includes routing policy to isolate peak windows and an automatic fallback to Hosted if capacity is saturated.

I'll ping Ben/ Priya internally to validate the discount geometry and any standard SOW language. Can we do a 30-min call tomorrow morning to review sizing?

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: MedCanvas pilot — ask on discounts and packaging

Ben / Priya / Marissa —

Looping you in to confirm economics before I send the formal proposal to Elliot + Procurements. Elliot's constraints: 99th <200ms during peaks, expected avg ~150k tokens/day with spikes to ~600k. He prefers a clear on-ramp and a rollback path.

My proposed packaging (quick):
- Offer A (Low lift): Hosted + $25k committed credit, 10% overage discount for the 8-week pilot.
- Offer B (Latency-first): 3-month Dedicated pilot — reserve 2 GPUs, 20% credit month 1, then 15% month 2–3 if committed throughput is maintained. Include an SLA exception for the pilot period to ensure priority routing.

Ask: can Sales approve a firm 20% first-month credit and 15% thereafter for Offer B? Also want to clarify whether we can include one month of free migration support (engineer hours) in the SOW.

If we can, I'll send both options to Elliot with a recommended path (Offer B) + a DocuSign for the MAP draft.

Thanks — Sofia
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear ask. I support Offer B as the recommended path for the customer given the latency requirement. Approvals/notes:
- Pricing guidance: base Dedicated rate for 2x A100-equiv is $28k/mo. With the proposed credits that would look like: month1 = $22.4k (20% credit), months2–3 = $23.8k/mo (15% credit).
- We can offer 20% first-month credit as a standard onramp for a 3-month committed Dedicated pilot.
- We should cap the engineering migration support at 40 hours as a line item in the SOW (included at no charge). Anything beyond that we bill at standard SE rate.

I'll let Contracts (Marissa) confirm SOW language but Sales is OK with the discount geometry above.

— Ben

Subject: Pilot options — formal summary and next steps

Hi Elliot — thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is a short MAP draft that outlines both tracks and the mechanics for rollback. Summary below: 

Option 1 — Hosted onramp (fastest start)
- 8-week Hosted pilot with $25k committed credit.
- 10% overage discount during pilot window.
- Pros: No infra changes, fastest to production.
- Cons: Variable tail latency during peaks; may not meet 99th <200ms consistently.

Option 2 — Dedicated pilot (recommended to meet latency)
- 3-month Dedicated reservation: 2x A100-equiv GPUs.
- Pricing: month1 = $22,400 (20% onramp credit), months2–3 = $23,800/mo (15% credit).
- Includes 40 hours of migration support at no charge; automatic fallback routing to Hosted if Dedicated pool is saturated.
- We will include pilot SLA language in the MAP and a clause for an ordered rollback to Hosted and pro rata credits if SLOs are not met.

Next steps:
1) Tell me which option you prefer and any changes Procurements needs.
2) If you want Option 2, I'll send the MAP and a DocuSign link for signature (draft attached).
3) Once signed we schedule a kickoff with Solutions + Infra to lock sizing and routing policy.

DocuSign link (draft): https://www.docusign.com/prepare/DC-4982-MAP
Attachment: MedCanvas-MAP-draft.pdf

Looking forward — happy to hop on a final call if needed.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
